description: Opt-in background frozen-snapshot fork probes. Normal results are silent; mismatches notify and pause work through a synchronous tool guard. Requires hook trust review.

hooks.command: node -e "Promise.resolve().then(()=>import(require('node:url').pathToFileURL(require('node:path').join(process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT||process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT,'scripts','guard.mjs')).href)).then(m=>m.main(['hook'])).catch(e=>console.log(JSON.stringify({systemMessage:'ModelTrace Guard failed to start: '+e.message+'. Task pauses and switch consent are not enforced until this is fixed.'})))"
